name: The Sublimation Station Inc.
old_description: Experience the difference of full-dye sublimation. Lighter weight, breathable, and vibrant forever.
about:
The Sublimation Station Inc. operates from Orlando, Florida, where it began as a print shop driven by a vision to be different. The founders, inspired by the city’s diverse culture of art, innovation, and creativity, set out to build a vertically integrated operation that would not be “anything less” than the creative energy around them.

The company produces custom dye-sublimation merchandise including all-over-print apparel (t‑shirts, hoodies, sportswear), blankets, accessories, and home‑goods. Its in‑house process covers printing on advanced printheads running over 2,500 sq ft/hr, calendar and flat‑bed heat presses, a 150 W laser cutter with camera registration, serger and coverstitch sewing, and finishing options such as hem tags and branded neck labels. The facility stocks more than 10,000 yards of fabric and has same‑day access to a major wholesale supplier, enabling a print‑on‑demand model with no minimum order quantity on sportswear.

Customers range from individual creators to brands and teams seeking custom merchandise, apparel, youth items, accessories, home‑and‑living products, and team sportswear. The Station also provides fulfillment and drop‑shipping so clients can focus on sales and marketing.

The business emphasizes sustainability through its print‑on‑demand approach, which reduces waste by producing only what is ordered, and by sourcing organic fabrics, recycled materials, and non‑toxic inks. Energy‑efficient equipment further lowers the carbon footprint. Direct‑to‑film printing, unlimited personalization, and rush‑order service round out the offering.
